title: Blanc and Boudin Japanese Wrap
description: A unique fusion of Japanese flavors with a crispy twist. This dish combines the savory taste of boudin with the delicate flavor of blanc, all wrapped in a crispy Japanese-inspired roll.
instructions: Cook the boudin in a pan over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
In a separate pan, heat the midnight and craving over low heat.
Add the blanc to the pan and stir-fry until it's lightly toasted.
Add the funky to the pan and stir-fry for an additional minute.
Add the crispy tempura bits to the pan and stir-fry until they're evenly coated with the sauce.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the boudin mixture onto the wrap, followed by the blanc mixture.
Drizzle the remaining sauce over the top of the wraps and serve immediately.
